TEXT:
[FI] I brought up the topic during breakfast, in front of 
the whole family.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Dad, Mom, may I have a moment?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
[FI] There's someone I want to introduce to you all 
today.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] So... as a matter of fact...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
[FI] I had her come all the way, she's outside the house 
right now.
[FI] That idiot Kanako, you came way too early!

[FI] Even though she's usually late... Well, this is another 
form of "not showing up on time", I guess.

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT: [FI] In that case, hurry and have her come in.

SPEAKER: SPK_YOSHINO
TEXT: [FI] That's right~, it's hot outside, you know?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Y-Yeah... I'll bring her in now then.

SPEAKER: SPK_YOSHINO
TEXT: [FI] He's certainly a smooth operator, right Dear?

SPEAKER: SPK_YOSHINO
TEXT: [FI] Still... what kind of person is his girlfriend, I wonder...

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT: [FI] Isn't it that girl? You know, from the Tamura family.

SPEAKER: SPK_YOSHINO
TEXT:
[FI] Manami-chan? But if it's her, we've met many times 
already, why would she introduce herself again?

SPEAKER: SPK_YOSHINO
TEXT:
[FI] Do you know anything, Kirino? About Kyousuke's 
girlfriend.

SPEAKER: SPK_YOSHINO
TEXT:
[FI] I see~ Fufufu, I wonder if she's someone I 
know~♪

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] I'll introduce you. This is my girlfriend...

SPEAKER: SPK_KANAKO
TEXT:
[FI] Long time no see, Auntie♪ Nice to meet you, 
Uncle♪

[FI] In full put-on mode, Kanako bobbed her head and 
bowed.

SPEAKER: SPK_KANAKO
TEXT: [FI] ...Hey, I just fucked up, didn't I?

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT: [FI] I'm Kousaka Daisuke, nice to meet you.

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT: [FI] No need to be so tense, speak normally.

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT: [FI] It must be tiring to keep up the act.
[FI] ...Whoa, it was seen through instantly, wasn't it?

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: [FI] [font_size=15]...I-diot, there's no way that put-on act would work on Dad.[/font_size]
[FI] Dad was extremely skilled at seeing through lies.
[FI] It's part of his job, after all.

[FI] Kanako who had her put-on specialty sealed then 
says-

SPEAKER: SPK_KANAKO
TEXT: [FI] For real?! I'll just talk normally then~

[FI] Foolishly honest, she switched to a way of speaking 
that exposed her idiocy.

SPEAKER: SPK_KANAKO
TEXT: [FI] Old man, you understand quite well, dontcha~

SPEAKER: SPK_KANAKO
TEXT:
[FI] Ah, but stuff like acting is Kanako's super specialty, 
so it ain't tiring at all.

SPEAKER: SPK_YOSHINO
TEXT:
[FI] Ah, um, Dear, Kanako-chan is Kirino's classmate, she 
actually visits quite often~!

[FI] Mom quickly changed the subject expecting some 
follow-up, but...

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: [FI] ...I'm going upstairs. I'll just be in the way anyways.
[FI] Don't you normally support your friends, at least?

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT:
[FI] ...About your acting specialty, did you mean your 
club activities or something?

SPEAKER: SPK_KANAKO
TEXT: [FI] Kanako wants to be an idol, to be honest.

SPEAKER: SPK_KANAKO
TEXT:
[FI] Since I plan on singing, dancing, and becoming an 
actress.

SPEAKER: SPK_KANAKO
TEXT: [FI] Don't mistake that part, alright? Heehee~

[FI] This is how her first encounter with her boyfriend's 
parents goes?

[FI] I kinda hoped for her to make it through with her 
acting, but-
[FI] The way it's going, it was impossible.

[FI] I'll think of it as "There's no point in this if they 
didn't see her true self".
[FI] With a solemn nod, Dad contemplated briefly.
[FI] He slowly opened his mouth to speak.

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT: [FI] -You understand what I'm trying to say, right?
